manaus.name: Manaus — Meeting of the Waters (Rio Negro / Solimões)
manaus.story: The Amazon's largest city. The Manaus river gauge has tracked the basin's pulse since 1902: record flood in 2021 (La Niña) and record drought in 2023 (El Niño).

tefe.name: Tefé / Mamirauá — Solimões floodplain
tefe.story: Seasonally flooded várzea forest. In the 2023 drought Lake Tefé overheated and hundreds of river dolphins died; riverside communities were cut off.
